The reproducibility script passed rational identities, independent covariance inversion and 4500 supplementary random alternatives.

value.rationale: Joint precision-budgeted quadrature design is a natural resource allocation question. The theorem resolves globally optimal active sensor count, equal precision rigidity, node geometry and risk for every finite n and P, including quantifying a continuous contraction of the optimal mesh under noise. Its cubic cell lemma is a structural exact optimization rather than an arbitrary finite computation; external validity is limited to the stated prior and cost model.
